intake_code.description: Opaque code assigned by intake before routing; interpret only with the declared codebook version.

channel.description: Channel through which the record arrived: web or phone.

expedited.description: Whether the requester selected expedited handling before routing.

scope.description: Whether the intake is routine or an exceptional process.
Only routine helpdesk intake is within this bounded extraction task. Exceptional and other scopes require separate evidence.

label_semantics.resolved: An explicit synthetic historical judgment. targets is a complete set for this record and can contain zero, one, or multiple target IDs.
label_semantics.unannotated: No routing judgment is available. targets is null; this record supplies no positive or negative training labels.
label_semantics.disputed: The historical judgment is unresolved. targets is null; acceptable_targets lists alternative complete target sets for uncertainty-aware assessment, not training.
label_semantics.empty_targets: An explicit resolved empty set means that no listed route was assigned. It is distinct from unannotated null.
